'''2008 Worlds Team Scott Church LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Church]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Sheet title Da Da Da Whap it good. Geoff Dearing note on form. Naboo WHAP package.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Scott Church]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Mind What You Have Learned|We'll Handle This]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
